newsitem.title: DENMARK: Virgin could double Brussels-Copenhagen flights.
newsitem.headline: Virgin could double Brussels-Copenhagen flights.

text.p: British tycoon Richard Branson's Virgin Express cut-price short-haul airline said on Wednesday that its Brussels-Copenhagen service had proved so successful since its inception last month that a second daily flight could be added.
"We are seriously considering an additional flight between Brussels and Copenhagen in November," Virgin Express CEO Jonathan Ornstein told Reuters by telephone from the airline's Brussels base.
Virgin has said it sees Scandinavian routes, characterised by high prices and good passenger volume, as a likely area of expansion and expects to link Copenhagen, Stockholm and Oslo in the future.
